participant_1.name: Sophie
participant_1.personality: Sophie is adventurous and lively, always ready to take on new challenges. She loves the thrill of riding her motorbike and enjoys meeting new people.
participant_1.background: I waitress during the day to supplement my income. I wear a motorbike helmet to protect my head. I have light skin with big brown eyes. My main transportation is my motorbike.
